item.title: DeWine warns abolishing property taxes could trigger major tax increases; Gallia officials weigh in
item.description: GALLIPOLIS, Ohio — Ohio Gov. Mike DeWine warned last week that a proposed constitutional amendment to abolish property taxes could push Ohio’s sales tax into the double digits and force lawmakers to consider significant income tax increases to replace the…

item.title: Driver killed, child hospitalized after vehicle plunges into Ohio River in Pomeroy
item.description: POMEROY, Ohio — One woman was killed and a female child is recuperating after a vehicle crashed and entered the Ohio River on Tuesday night.

item.title: Point Pleasant City Council approves traffic code amendment, cemetery contract and event plans at February meeting
item.description: POINT PLEASANT, W.Va. — The Point Pleasant City Council convened on Monday, approving several measures and receiving updates on ongoing city projects.

item.title: Woman dead after vehicle plunges into Ohio River, but child is rescued; search continues for body of driver in Pomeroy
item.description: POMEROY, Ohio — A woman died and a young girl is recovering after a vehicle crashed into the Ohio River on Tuesday night, authorities said. Efforts to recover the driver’s body continued Thursday, according to the Pomeroy Police Department.

item.title: Southern Local inducts Dalle Teaford Jr. and Robert E. Beegle into Hall of Fame Class of 2026
item.description: RACINE, Ohio — The Southern Local School District held its annual Hall of Fame Induction Ceremony on Feb. 5 prior to the varsity boys basketball game against Federal Hocking.

item.title: Mason police seize suspected drugs, arrest homeowner after executing search warrant
item.description: MASON, W.Va. — Members of the Mason Metro Police Department executed a lawfully issued search warrant Saturday night at a residence on Wyatt Street, seizing multiple suspected controlled substances and arresting the homeowner.

item.title: WVDNR reminds hunters, trappers of small game and furbearer season closures
item.description: CHARLESTON, W.Va. — The West Virginia Division of Natural Resources is reminding hunters and trappers that seasons for several small game and fur-bearing species are set to close Feb. 28.

item.title: Ohio launches new round of High School Tech Internship Program for students, employers
item.description: COLUMBUS, Ohio — The Ohio Department of Development and the Governor’s Office of Workforce Transformation have announced the opening of a new internship round for Ohio students and businesses seeking opportunities in technology fields.

item.title: Marshall Health Network names Matt James vice president of foundations
item.description: HUNTINGTON, W.Va. — Marshall Health Network has named Matt James as its new vice president of foundations, a key executive leadership role responsible for advancing philanthropic strategy and strengthening alignment across the system’s affiliated foundations.
